title: فانوس دریایی و کشتی
logline_fa: کشتی کوچکی در شب مه‌آلود راه را گم کرده؛ چراغ فانوس دریایی می‌چرخد، هر بار که نورش به کشتی می‌خورد کشتی کمی نزدیک‌تر می‌شود تا به بندر برسد.
ratio_note: 9x16 first, then a true 16:9 re-design (not a crop)

protagonist.what: a small ship with two porthole eyes
protagonist.build: SVG hull + sail + 2 circles as eyes; bob = sine on y and rotation around keel pivot; fog as 3 pre-blurred ellipse layers (no live filter)
protagonist.state_change: lost and small in dark fog -> lit, large, docked with eyes looking up at the light

beats.what: dark sea, ship alone, eyes scanning
lighthouse beam sweeps; each hit reveals more sea, ship drifts toward it
camera pushes along the beam, parallax of waves and fog
ship docks, beam rests on it, copy appears

payoffs.viewer_gets: first sweep hits the ship and eyes widen
ship jumps with joy, squash boing
world opens, fog parts, harbour lights appear
ship settles, one beam pulse on the copy

assets: SVG lighthouse, ship, waves, fog layers, beam as gradient polygon
kit sfx: swell, clunk, boing, horn, bell, waves

tests: continuous camera on one big stage
light sweep as a driving clock
acceptance: run-gates clean on both 9x16 and 16x9 stills
pacing ranges within the BPM band, no cut shorter than 0.8 s
transition strip viewed: no jump in ship position across camera moves
lab.risk: medium; the 16:9 layout is a second composition and may eat the budget
